findings.message: CMake platform condition `WIN32 OR CYGWIN` has no QNX case
findings.suggestion: This branch selects sources, flags or libraries per platform but never names QNX. QNX toolchain files set CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME to QNX (and often QNX TRUE), and QNX notes that CMake conditionals checking CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME need to be extended for QNX; decide whether QNX belongs in this condition (e.g. add `AND NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "QNX"` or an elseif branch).

Host OS case `# We don't use pthreads on MinGW.
    PT` in a dispatch with no nto-qnx* case
findings.suggestion: GNU configure names QNX targets *-nto-qnx* (e.g. aarch64-unknown-nto-qnx8.0.0); add a *-nto-qnx* case next to these or confirm the default branch is right for QNX.

findings.message: Platform branch for __APPLE__ has no __QNX__ case
findings.suggestion: This conditional selects code for other Unix-like systems (BSD/macOS/Solaris/AIX/HP-UX) but never for QNX. qcc defines __QNX__ (800 for QNX 8.0); check whether QNX should take this branch (add `|| defined(__QNX__)`) or the other one (add `&& !defined(__QNX__)`).

findings.message: Linux link library 'pthread'
findings.suggestion: On QNX 8.0 pthread_create() is documented in libc, which qcc usually links automatically; drop or guard libpthread for QNX builds.

findings.message: Linux-only preprocessor condition
findings.suggestion: This branch is Linux-only. qcc defines __QNX__ (value 800 for QNX 8.0; e.g. #if defined(__QNX__) && __QNX__ >= 800); add a QNX branch. __QNXNTO__ is deprecated.
